profile: attention masking: In graph neural networks, attention masking is a technique that restricts each node's attention to itself and its immediate neighbors. This prevents nodes from attending to distant or unrelated nodes, so aggregation uses local graph structure. The masked attention mechanism focuses the model on relevant connections while ignoring others.
